name: Turbo Crust
notes: Use: louder, more open crust and punk. CLIP none leaves only the op-amp rails clipping: more level, less compression, a rawer edge. Into a plexi-style amp (TONE3000 76884) kept clean-ish so the pedal does the work. VOLUME sits very low (0.54) because CLIP none, with only the op-amp rails clipping, is about 20 dB louder than the diode clips. Single path, no captures: renders from files in this repo only (the shared cab is the repo identity IR, a stand-in for a real cab). Rat-style op-amp distortion model (pedal.rat, VERMIN). Starting hypotheses, not a tuned tone.
